insights.content: On days you took Inositol, your average symptom severity was 2.3/5 compared to 3.1/5 on missed days (n=126 supplement logs, 76% confidence). Maintaining consistent daily intake may continue to reduce symptom burden.

insights.content: Acne and breakout severity averaged 3.4/5 two to three days after medium/high-GI meals versus 2.1/5 after low-GI meals. Reducing high-GI foods may help manage skin symptoms.
insights.title: Acne breakouts correlate with high-GI meals

insights.content: On nights with more than 7 hours of sleep, your next-day symptom severity averaged 2.1/5 compared to 3.2/5 after shorter sleep (n=45 daily logs, 68% confidence). Prioritizing sleep quality may reduce overall symptom impact.
insights.title: Better sleep correlates with milder symptoms

insights.content: Fatigue severity was 0.8 points higher on average during December-February compared to October-November. Seasonal changes in light exposure and activity levels may contribute to this pattern.
insights.title: Winter months show increased fatigue
